name: Life
definition: Events related to personal relationships, family status, and living arrangements.

name: Conflict
definition: Events related to war, violence, crime, legal actions, and protests.

name: Transaction
definition: Events related to commercial exchange, financial activities, and employment.

name: Movement
definition: Events related to physical travel, transportation, and displacement.

name: Arts_Entertainment
definition: Events related to artistic creation, performance, media, and entertainment.

name: Sports
definition: Events related to athletic competitions, games, and sports awards.

name: Politics
definition: Events related to government, elections, and civic leadership.

name: Education
definition: Events related to academic institutions, learning, and scholarship.

name: Communication
definition: Events related to speech, correspondence, and information exchange.

name: Miscellaneous
definition: Triggers that are abstract, referential, or do not fit other categories.
